notes.title: The Diary of Harold Castillo
notes.content:
There are several pages to be found in the first episode "I'm Still Alive". 

You can learn about a very dark and macabre story by collecting all the pages.

Some are easy to find, some will be hiding in very unusual places. 

Can you find them all?
